paragraph_text: The Beneficiary satisfies 8 C.F.R. §204.5(h)(3)(i) by demonstrating receipt of nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field. The Beneficiary was selected as a scholar of Beijing's 'Hundred People Project,' a prestigious talent recognition program that identifies and supports exceptional academics in China [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This selection demonstrates that the Beneficiary has been recognized at the highest levels of academic excellence in China, as the program specifically targets scholars who have made significant contributions to their fields [Exhibit A1, p.2]. The 'Hundred People Project' represents a highly competitive selection process, as it identifies only a limited number of scholars from across all academic disciplines in Beijing, one of China's leading educational and research centers [Exhibit A1, p.2]. This award places the Beneficiary among an elite group of scholars recognized for their outstanding contributions to academic research and innovation [Exhibit A1, p.2]. Furthermore, the Beneficiary's work 'On Age' won the third prize of Outstanding Achievements in Humanities and Social Sciences of the Ministry of Education of China, a nationally recognized award established by the Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China on March 12, 2009 [Exhibit A1, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.2; Exhibit B10, p.3]. This award is administered by the Ministry of Education, which established it to 'reward researchers who have made outstanding contributions in the field of humanities and social sciences' and 'encourage active exploration and innovation' [Exhibit B10, p.4]. The selection process is rigorous and occurs only every three years, with awards divided into grand prizes, first prizes, second prizes, and third prizes across multiple categories including books, papers, and research reports [Exhibit B10, p.4, p.5]. The evaluation committee comprises 'experts and scholars with high academic attainments and excellent style of study from the whole country' who conduct 'qualitative and quantitative evaluation' of application materials [Exhibit B10, p.5, p.6]. While the Beneficiary received the third prize, this represents a significant achievement given the national scope and competitive nature of this award, which recognizes only the most outstanding research contributions across all of China's higher education institutions [Exhibit B10, p.5]. In addition to the above, the Beneficiary received the Data Legacy of the Year Award at the 2019 Data Awards, which are pronounced the same as 'beacon' in Chinese and represent 'one of the most influential awards in the field of mobile Internet' [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit B3, p.2]. These awards were jointly launched by Umen+, Zhongguancun Big Data Industry Alliance, Tsingdata Big Data Industries Association, and China Big Data Industry Observation to 'motivate benchmarking enterprises for data-based construction in the big data industry, as well as experts with outstanding contributions and influence' [Exhibit B3, p.3]. The selection process involved a jury of 21 judges from dozens of authorities and industry experts and scholars including China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, Tsinghua University, and Peking University, who reviewed candidates during a two-month review period [Exhibit B3, p.3]. From this rigorous evaluation, only 28 Data individuals stood out across seven categories of Data Awards, making the Beneficiary's recognition particularly selective [Exhibit B3, p.4]. The Data Legacy of the Year Award specifically recognizes individuals who 'have been working deeply in the field of big data and mobile Internet for many years, spreading their insights and experiences and educating the whole industry' and who 'lead many Internet practitioners to continuously inherit data application, industry methodology and scientific research' [Exhibit B3, p.7]. Moreover, the Beneficiary's paper titled 'Challenges Posed by the Internet to Traditional Media in the Time Dimension - A Study on the Possibility of Internet Media Usage Time Surpassing Traditional Media Usage Time' won the Excellent Paper Award at the 11th China Communication Conference in 2010 [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award was issued by the Communication Association of China and the 11th China Communication Conference Organizing Committee, indicating recognition from a major national professional organization in the field of communication studies [Exhibit B11, p.2]. The China Communication Conference represents a significant national gathering of communication scholars and professionals, making paper awards at this conference highly competitive and selective [Exhibit B11, p.2]. This award demonstrates that the Beneficiary's research has been recognized as excellent by peers in the communication field at a major national conference [Exhibit B11, p.2]. Additionally, the Beneficiary has received additional recognition through various industry and enterprise awards that demonstrate broad impact across multiple sectors [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These include recognition as an 'Enterprise Service High-growth Company' by 36 Kr, inclusion in the 'China Big Data Industry Application TOP Choice Three Major Fields,' and selection for the '2019 China Big Data Innovative Enterprises TOP 100' by the Data Technology Industry Innovation Institute (DTiii) [Exhibit B4, p.4]. The Beneficiary also received the '2018 Excellent Team Award of Internet Security Management' from the Chaoyang Public Security Branch Network Security Guarding Brigade and the 'Annual Best Retailing Intelligent Data Application Award' at the 14th Shanghai Retail Industry Summit & Retail Innovation Summit 2019 [Exhibit B4, p.4]. These diverse awards from respected industry organizations and government bodies demonstrate the Beneficiary's recognition across multiple domains including enterprise services, big data innovation, internet security, and retail technology applications [Exhibit B4, p.4]. In sum, the foregoing evidence clearly establishes that the Beneficiary has received nationally and internationally recognized awards for excellence in the field.
